english: When the plane arrived, some of the detectives were waiting inside the main building while others were waiting on the airfield.
text: 句子先用 When the plane arrived 给出一个时间落点，再用 while 把两组侦探的并行等待并置在一起：一些在主楼里，另一些在机场。描述同一时刻分两组同步行动，用 while 两边对照着说，画面会更清楚。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
